MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-30; reviewed_by stays null): status changed from blocked PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED to pass. The clone tracks paths that differ only in case (BACK.stl and Back.stl, FRONT.stl and Front.stl, in two directories), so on this case-insensitive file system one of them always read as modified and G1 failed; the gate now leaves such paths out while the file holds the content of one of them (MHS/changes/WAVE-B2.md). The author did not write in the clone. The reviewer re-ran the gate and recorded the pass. The author's notes as written at the time of the block follow. (After the registry rebuild the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.)

The required acceptance command fails G1 before the driver gates run:

G1 fail Layout and isolation
  error G1.CLONE_MODIFIED: the upstream clone has modified tracked files: ['mini_ros/stl/OpenQuadruped/BACK.stl', 'mini_ros/stl/OpenQuadruped/FRONT.stl', 'spotmicro/util/pybullet_data/assets/urdf/stl/OpenQuadruped/BACK.stl', 'spotmicro/util/pybullet_data/assets/urdf/stl/OpenQuadruped/FRONT.stl'] (the clone is read-only; restore it)
G2 pass Lock
G3 pass Strict resolve
G4 pass Provenance
G5 pass Reference
G6 warn Behaviour (G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL)
G7 pass Native surface
G8 warn Protocol and surface (G8.NO_UNIT x4)
G9 skip Repository tests
FAIL: G1

Cause: this host is macOS with a case-insensitive APFS workspace, while the pinned clone tracks both mini_ros/stl/OpenQuadruped/BACK.stl and mini_ros/stl/OpenQuadruped/Back.stl (and the FRONT/Front pair, in two directories). The checkout stores one blob under both names, so git status reports the uppercase entries modified. The clone cannot be made clean without writing into it or hiding the entries in its git index, and hard rule 1 forbids modifying the clone, so no package change can fix G1.

Verification only, not the acceptance run: the same package passes G1-G9 against a scratch clone in /tmp whose four case-colliding index entries were marked skip-worktree, with digest sha256:46f6c8d6f724a8a08556195557ff44ba0ca78acd716da98817d36ac51f0d313 and the same two warning classes (G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL, G8.NO_UNIT x4). The card's local_path was not changed. No hardware backend was run and no human review is claimed.
